verdict.rationale: Formant has a dedicated docs page for triggering webhooks from events. It describes outbound HTTP calls to any endpoint, fired by a Formant event trigger, which matches subscribing to events via webhooks. That page is the only evidence, so the depth of the capability is unproven. Missing for 10: payload schema details, programmatic (API-based) webhook registration, delivery guarantees/retries and signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook allows you to make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event.
